title: Category:Bosses
html:
Boss Mobs are those that you find at the very end of a dungeon - usually in their own Lair. They are very tough, and usually have normal mobs and Champions with them as well. Each is Unique.

In addition to the information contained here, also check out the Boss Guide for tips from members on fighting the various bosses.
